descriptions.notStarted: I arrived at the majestic temple high above the sky, the Temple of Time.  A fussy looking #b#p2140000##k standing in front of the three doors begins to talk to me...
descriptions.inProgress: #p2140000# said there was an incident recently where an intruder broke in through the Door to the Past and that until the case is resolved, they will not be letting regular visitors inside the Temple of Time.  He says if I really want to go in, I can, but it will be a waste of time...  Well, should I just #bgo in for now#k?
descriptions.completed: #p2140000# said because time goes backwards in Memory Lane, you can't go forward unless you are given permission.  He says I would need to get permission from the Goddess... How do I get permission from the Goddess?
